thread:
Asha: Quick sync 1 opened PR to consolidate rate-limit examples and add a tiny usage-analytics dashboard snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912
Tom: Dropped by. What's the change to the pricing table specifically?
Asha: Wording: change 'per-1k tokens' -> 'per 1K tokens (prompt + completion)'; add an embeddings billing example (per 1K vector-units). Also adding a short FAQ blurb about burst credits and quota windows.
Vera: For the dashboard snippet I used ${DS_BILLING} variable so deployments can substitute prom_billing or billing_prom. Left a note in the panel JSON.
Tom: Nice. On the SDK example, can we keep it a single-line for the docs card? I propose: `await Redwood.client.generate({model:'redwood-small', headers:{'x-rw-billing-mode':'metered'}})`
Asha: That looks good. We need to decide canonical header name and include a migration table mapping old aliases.
Leo: Suggest `x-rw-usage` -> `x-rw-billing-mode` in the migration table. I'll open the SDK follow-up PR after docs merge.
Vera: Link-check popped one broken anchor from /pricing#limits. I added a redirect and updated internal links in the PR.
Tom: Can we include a 1-line exponential backoff snippet for 429s? Keeps support noise down.
DocsBot: ```py
# backoff example (pseudo)
for attempt in range(3):
  try:
    call_api()
    break
  except RateLimitError:
    sleep(base*(2**attempt)+random())
```
Asha: Thanks all. Plan: merge after Leo opens SDK PR and Vera attaches the panel screenshot (1200x320). I'll add a docs release-note bullet. :rocket:
